verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo describes a free, open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, with full control of the data plane, and the docs call it an open-source observability platform. Community users confirm self-hosting is a real option, though they find the multi-container deployment heavy and hit Windows/shell dependency issues. missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting install/operations docs in the evidence, clarity on whether 'ee/' licensed features are excluded from the self-hosted open-source build, and evidence of a lighter or Windows-friendly deployment path.
